'''Jedi Yoda ECC Jedi Training''' is a [[Light]] deck by Jedi Yoda, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/deck00d.htm Ecc Jedi Training], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228054332/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/deck00d.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
